initial_preseason_camp_recovery.task: Force and impulse innovations at H72 / D7
initial_preseason_camp_recovery.metric: Four-cell public selection; production calibration unavailable.
initial_preseason_camp_recovery.relevance: Separate forecasting from recovery interpretation in a camp setting.
initial_preseason_camp_recovery.limitation: Superseded sample/surface; direct parent is unresolved; task and world law match the canonical state.
initial_preseason_camp_recovery.modelEvidence: Linear baseline and M0 inference adapters exist. The historical 39-column projection is absent; a preserved private M0 checkpoint is not auto-loaded.

canonical_preseason_camp_recovery.task: Force and impulse innovations at H72 / D7
canonical_preseason_camp_recovery.metric: Native scorer exists; calibration and historical model binding unresolved.
canonical_preseason_camp_recovery.relevance: Make each requested horizon explicit without inventing a new world law.
canonical_preseason_camp_recovery.limitation: Canonical query surface and sample; not a new task or world law.
canonical_preseason_camp_recovery.modelEvidence: Historical five-run campaign is numeric result evidence only; no runnable historical M3 model use is registered.

rich_history_camp_recovery.task: Force and impulse innovations at H72 / D7

rich_history_camp_recovery.limitation: Retired formulation; its direct scientific parent is unresolved.
rich_history_camp_recovery.modelEvidence: Registered zero-innovation baseline is executable. Historical empirical-Bayes, boosted-residual and headroom results are evidence only. The new public ridge study is a separate experiment.

preliminary_post_exposure_recovery.limitation: Direct parent is unresolved; preliminary measurement contract without a frozen force–impulse identity.

phase_consistent_post_exposure_recovery.modelEvidence: Historical ridge research result is evidence only; no executable M3 model adapter is registered.

correlated_exposure_recovery.modelEvidence: Historical local, frontier and other predictor families are result evidence only; no exact historical numerical replay is qualified.

fixed_mode_discrepancy_recovery.task: Force and net-impulse innovations at H24 / H48 / H72
fixed_mode_discrepancy_recovery.metric: Six-cell research NRMSE and relative-progress diagnostics; production scorer not implemented.
